primitive.meaning: The certificate operation (status), or error for the stop-level exception arm.

role.meaning: Normalized appliance profile used by the certificate operation.

changed.meaning: Whether the primitive reports a change; some failure paths may report partial effects.

dry_run.meaning: Whether the primitive returned a dry-run receipt; a refusal before planning can report false.

state_generation.meaning: Ledger generation as stored; defaults to 0 when absent.

client_reinstall_required.meaning: Whether clients must reinstall trust for the reported operation.

profile.meaning: Certificate role resolved from the appliance profile.

root_present.meaning: Whether the local root certificate file is present.

bundle_installed.meaning: Installed trust status, read from the ledger when present, otherwise observed on non-HomeServer roles; normally boolean.

portals.meaning: HomeServer portal inventory as held in the ledger; defaults to an empty array.

constituents.meaning: HomeServer constituent inventory as held in the ledger; defaults to an empty array.

browser_trust.meaning: For non-HomeServer roles, whether the browser trust bridge is active, or unsupported.

ca_fingerprint.meaning: Fingerprint of the local CA, or the recorded root fingerprint when the file is absent.

ca_not_after.meaning: OpenSSL notAfter text for the House CA certificate.
